#### GetSeedClient

```text
public Microsoft.PowerPlatform.Dataverse.Client.ServiceClient GetSeedClient()
```

Gets the seed ServiceClient for cloning.


Returns: An authenticated, ready-to-use ServiceClient. The pool will clone this client to create pool members.

Remarks: This method is called once per source. The result is cached by the pool. Implementations may create the client lazily on first call.

#### InvalidateSeed

```text
public System.Void InvalidateSeed()
```

Invalidates the cached seed client, forcing fresh authentication on next use.


Remarks: Call this when a token failure is detected. The next call to PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.IConnectionSource.GetSeedClient will create a new client with fresh authentication instead of returning the cached one. Implementations should dispose the old client if it exists and clear any internal cache. This method should be thread-safe and idempotent.
